description: This file implements the VideoTrackSourceImpl class, which provides a WebRTC video source for capturing video frames, wrapping frame buffers, and managing video frame statistics within the cuttlefish project.

classes.name: VideoFrameWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class implementing webrtc::I420BufferInterface, providing access to frame buffer data and properties.

methods.name: VideoTrackSourceImpl::OnFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming video frames, wraps them, and forwards to the broadcaster.

methods.name: VideoTrackSourceImpl::GetStats
methods.description: Provides current input height and width statistics.

methods.name: VideoTrackSourceImpl::SupportsEncodedOutput
methods.description: Indicates whether encoded output is supported; returns false.

methods.name: VideoTrackSourceImpl::source
methods.description: Returns the video source interface for WebRTC.
